title: b7z9.29.4: Python+Rust: implement PacketErrorPermille tracker
description: Spec R-02a-133: metrics over rolling RF_METRICS_WINDOW_SF=32 superframes. Track TX failures vs total TX attempts per superframe window. Compute PacketErrorPermille = (failures / total) * 1000. Feed into interference_score_tenths(). No implementation exists. Add unit tests.
close_reason: PacketErrorPermille tracker landed (spec R-02a-133 / 2a.10.3, MUST: per-superframe TX failure vs total over the 32-SF rolling window): (1) Rust PacketErrorPermilleTracker in rust/lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs — heapless::Vec<(u64 sf, u32 total, u32 failed), 32> rolling window; record_attempt folds same-SF repeats, evicts oldest-by-SF when full, and early-returns for out-of-window NEW superframes when saturated (parity with Python dict semantics — no in-window eviction loss); packet_error_permille() retains the underflow-safe exclusive window (sf + 32 > current), sums failures/total, clamps the permille at 1000, empty window -> 0. (2) Python PacketErrorPermilleTracker in ccp.py with identical semantics. (3) Tests: rolling-window 300 permille (10 attempts, 3 failures across SF 0/1/2), boundary 500 -> 1000 transitions (SF 100 retained at current 131, dropped at 132), all-failure cap, empty-window branch exercised. The tracker feeds the existing interference_score_tenths consumer. Verification: cargo 363+2/363 green (incl. the pre-existing adaptive_sf_and_rebalance_matches_spec), Python 103/103 test_ccp green, clippy -D warnings clean, fmt clean, ruff clean for touched code (5 findings verified pre-existing at HEAD via stash — kpv0.3 scope). Codereview rounds (Kimi K3): pass 1 found 4 findings — (1) P3 eviction-parity gap fixed (early-return for out-of-window new SFs), (2)+(3) P4 comment tallies corrected, (4) empty-window branch now exercised; pass 2 (final) found 2 residual P4 comment-tally errors — fixed. All findings closed; no beads outstanding for this scope.
